info.title: DejaVu API V1
info.description: Public DejaVu V1 API for integrating collection, history, favorites, ratings, watchlist, scrobbling, lists, channels, connectors, and integration features.

tags.name: Collection
tags.description: Manage your personal collection of watched or owned movies and TV shows.

tags.name: History
tags.description: View and manage your watch history.

tags.name: Favorites
tags.description: Add and remove movies and TV shows from your favorites.

tags.name: Ratings
tags.description: Rate and review your movies, TV shows, seasons, and episodes.

tags.name: Scrobble
tags.description: Track playback progress in real time.

tags.name: Up Next
tags.description: Get the next episodes to watch for TV shows you follow.

tags.name: Lists
tags.description: Create and manage custom lists of movies and TV shows.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Expose dashboard configuration and widget content.

tags.name: Channels
tags.description: Channels and universes accessible to the user.

tags.name: Connectors

ApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyHeader.description: DejaVu API key. pk_* = read-only; sk_* = read and write.

BearerAuth.description: DejaVu API key sent in Authorization: Bearer <key>.

SessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
SessionCookie.description: DejaVu user session used to approve the Device Flow in the browser.

id.description: TMDB ID of the movie or episode. For an episode, it can be replaced by tvShowId + seasonNumber + episodeNumber.

tmdbId.description: Alias for the TV show TMDB ID used to resolve an episode by context.

tvShowId.description: TV show TMDB ID, used to resolve an episode.

HistoryInput.description: Adds a movie or episode to history. TV shows are not standalone history entries: use type=episode.

id.description: TMDB ID of the media or episode. For a season/episode, TV show context may be required.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number, required when the episode is resolved by context.

RatingInput.description: Adds or updates a rating from 1 to 10. Seasons and episodes use tvShowId and their S/E context.

id.description: TMDB ID of the movie or episode, optional if tmdbId or episode context is provided.

tmdbId.description: TMDB ID of the movie or TMDB ID of the TV show to resolve an episode.

tvShowId.description: TMDB ID of the TV show to resolve an episode.

seasonNumber.description: Season number to resolve an episode.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number to resolve an episode.

ScrobbleInput.description: Updates the progress of a movie or episode. At 90% or more, the content is automatically marked as watched.

id.description: TMDB ID of the media or episode. For an episode, it can be replaced by tvShowId + seasonNumber + episodeNumber.

tvShowId.description: TV show TMDB ID, used to resolve an episode.

ListItemInput.description: Adds a movie, TV show, or episode to a list. Rules depend on the list kind.

items.description: Array of media to query. It may be empty; the response then returns an empty data object.

definition.description: Must include definition.extractors. Selectors must not use a universal wildcard.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required. Use the x-api-key header or Authorization: Bearer <key>.
